name: tcc-adaptive-scheduler
description: Telemetry-driven main-thread vs Web Worker scheduler for client-side table computation, plus a WebExtension that collects its telemetry.

scripts.shops:install: npm --prefix apps/shop-react install && npm --prefix apps/shop-angular install
scripts.shops:build: npm --prefix apps/shop-react run build && npm --prefix apps/shop-angular run build && npm --prefix apps/shop-angular run build:zone
scripts.shops:check: npm --prefix apps/shop-react run check && npm --prefix apps/shop-angular run check
